speaker: Campaign Treasurer
title: Sweet Boxes of Cash
scenario: A prominent real estate developer brings 50 boxes of sweets stuffed with ₹2 crore in unaccounted cash to distribute to ward booth managers.

leftChoice.label: Reject Cash
leftChoice.explanation: You insist on transparent digital donations. The developer leaves angry, but vigilance agencies find nothing on you.

rightChoice.label: Distribute Quietly
rightChoice.explanation: Booth workers are energized with secret cash envelopes. Word leaks to election observers.

speaker: Infrastructure Contractor
title: Flyover Tender Kickback
scenario: A construction syndicate promises a 12% cut from the Nagarpur East Flyover contract into your election fund if you pre-clear their sub-standard cement mix.

leftChoice.label: Enforce Quality Audit
leftChoice.explanation: You insist on high-grade materials and independent lab testing. Citizens get a safe bridge; contractors grumble.

rightChoice.label: Approve Cut & Waiver
rightChoice.explanation: Your campaign war-chest swells. Three years later, civic engineers report dangerous hairline fractures on the overpass.

speaker: Hawala Courier
title: Intercepted Courier at Checkpost
scenario: A cash courier transporting ₹80 lakh without documentation has been stopped at the Nagarpur outer toll gate. The police inspector asks for a quiet call.

leftChoice.label: Let Law Take Course
leftChoice.explanation: The cash is seized and deposited in the treasury. You lose funding, but your legal record remains clean.

rightChoice.label: Intervene & Cover Up
rightChoice.explanation: The inspector lets the van go for a cut. A local journalist snaps a photo of the vehicle leaving the station.

speaker: Chartered Accountant
title: The Shell Company Carousel
scenario: Your chartered accountant proposes channeling ₹5 crore through 14 defunct shell companies registered at a single tin shed in Nagarpur Industrial Area.

leftChoice.label: File Legitimate Books
leftChoice.explanation: You pay full tax and declare standard corporate contributions. Capital is smaller, but no enforcement summons arrive.

rightChoice.label: Spin the Carousel
rightChoice.explanation: Black money turns into 'unsecured loans' overnight. The Financial Intelligence Unit flags the sudden spike in shell activity.

speaker: Slum Welfare Organizer
title: Liquor Distribution vs Water Pipeline
scenario: Ahead of Sunday's rally in Ward 11, local operatives demand ₹15 lakh for free liquor crates. Alternatively, residents are begging for emergency water tankers.

leftChoice.label: Send Water Tankers
leftChoice.explanation: Mothers and families bless your team; clean drinking water brings genuine goodwill, though drunkard cadres grumble.

rightChoice.label: Distribute Liquor
rightChoice.explanation: Rally attendance is deafening and rowdy. Domestic violence incidents surge overnight in the settlement.

speaker: Sand Mining Syndicate
title: Riverbed Extraction Royalty
scenario: The illegal Nagarpur river sand cartel offers to bankroll your entire social media army if you promise to look away from nighttime river dredging.

leftChoice.label: Impound Dredgers
leftChoice.explanation: River ecology is protected and ground water tables stabilize. The powerful sand mafia vows to support your rival.

rightChoice.label: Take the Social Fund
rightChoice.explanation: Influencers flood feeds with viral praising videos. Two monsoon bridges downstream experience severe pillar erosion.

speaker: Hospital Trustee
title: Diverting Dialysis Wing Grant
scenario: A state healthcare grant of ₹3 crore for Nagarpur General Hospital's new dialysis unit can be administratively 're-allocated' into election public-relation stunts.

leftChoice.label: Build the Dialysis Wing
leftChoice.explanation: Dozens of kidney patients receive subsidized life-saving care. You gain immense moral authority in the city.

rightChoice.label: Divert for PR Blitz
rightChoice.explanation: Giant LED billboards of your face illuminate every junction. Patients wait months on the kidney waiting list.

speaker: Agrarian Land Broker
title: Bogus Agricultural Income
scenario: An advisor suggests declaring ₹4 crore in untaxed political slush funds as 'bumper mango harvest profit' from a 2-acre fallow plot to exploit farm tax exemptions.

leftChoice.label: Decline Sham Exemption
leftChoice.explanation: You avoid agricultural tax fraud. Farm workers respect your refusal to abuse rural relief measures.

rightChoice.label: Claim Mango Millions
rightChoice.explanation: Tax inspectors note that the registered land has only 3 barren shrubs and no irrigation. A tax notice is drawn up.

speaker: Election Returning Officer
title: Midnight Recounting Delay
scenario: During a tight local council tally, an election official hints that for a 'discretionary contribution', they can delay ballot verification until your voters arrive.

leftChoice.label: Respect Voter Mandate
leftChoice.explanation: Votes are counted under CCTV in full view of observers. The integrity of the ballot box is preserved.

rightChoice.label: Pay the Discretionary Fee
rightChoice.explanation: The official declares unexpected technical delays. Protesters gather outside the counting center chanting slogans.

speaker: Benami Property Agent
title: Commercial Complex in Driver's Name
scenario: To park ₹8 crore of accumulated commission fees, a real estate agent suggests purchasing a 5-story shopping plaza under the name of your family driver.

leftChoice.label: Refuse Benami Shelter
leftChoice.explanation: You refuse to exploit a low-income employee as a proxy. Transparent ownership shields you from asset seizures.

rightChoice.label: Sign Power of Attorney
rightChoice.explanation: Rental yields pour into your hidden coffers. When the Anti-Corruption Bureau audits the driver's tax returns, sirens start blaring.

speaker: Opposition Vote Splitter
title: Funding Rival Dummy Candidates
scenario: Operatives propose paying ₹25 lakh cash to 4 dummy independent candidates with names identical to the main challenger to confuse voters at the ballot booth.

leftChoice.label: Fight on Track Record
leftChoice.explanation: You campaign on municipal policies and civic manifestos. Voters appreciate an honest electoral battle.

rightChoice.label: Fund the Namesakes
rightChoice.explanation: Voters are baffled at the booth, casting 3,000 mistaken votes. Civic groups label the election a cynical mockery.

speaker: Municipal Tax Officer
title: Whistleblower Intimidation
scenario: A public activist has uncovered shell company records linking local tenders to your campaign office. A corrupt tax commissioner offers to raid his NGO.

leftChoice.label: Release Public Audit
leftChoice.explanation: You open accounts for public scrutiny and reform campaign fundraising. The press applauds your transparency.

rightChoice.label: Unleash the Raids
rightChoice.explanation: The activist's office is sealed on trumped-up charges. Nagarpur's civil society erupts in candlelight demonstrations.
